summary: Selects a tire-compound tier integer from the global track-grip level flt_8AFEE8 using chained thresholds, with randomized boundaries at the mid ranges. Very low grip (< 0.15) falls back to the stored tier this[4451] (this+0x458C); 0.15..0.2 uses a randomized even/odd LCG test to choose between the fallback and tier 4; 0.2..0.55 selects 4 (with a random +1 at 0.5..0.55); 0.55..0.8 selects 5; 0.8..0.85 selects 6 minus a random bit; 0.85+ selects 6. The chosen tier is then mapped to a compound index by scanning the compound list behind the pointer this[3678] (this+0x3978), comparing each entry's name (via CompoundIndexLookup, null-fallback to byte_5EA438) against TireCompoundNameIDMapping; the last match index is returned.

operations.description: Tier-selection ladder on flt_8AFEE8: below 0.15 use the fallback tier this+0x458C (this[4451]); 0.15..0.2 call RandLCGRandomNumberGenerator(this) and test the low/sign bits (v4 & 0x80000001 == 0 idiom), using the fallback on zero result else falling through to tier 4; 0.2..0.55 yield tier 4 (with a random +1 via (rand % 2 != 0) in the 0.5..0.55 band); 0.55..0.8 yield tier 5; 0.8..0.85 yield 6 minus a random bit; 0.85+ yield tier 6.

Scan the compound list: v5 = 0; for i in 0..*(this[3678]+16) (list pointer at this+0x3978, count at +16), fetch entry name pointer v7 = *(char**)CompoundIndexLookup(i); if null use the default string byte_5EA438; if v2 == TireCompoundNameIDMapping(v7), record v5 = i. The last matching index wins.
Return the selected compound index v5.
